name: how-many-reports
title: How many grade reports are there?
idea: Grade reports far outnumber strict rankings (13 for three units, 4,683 for six, 545,835 for eight), while a cap or a fixed order leaves far fewer (for eight units, 6,051 with at most three grades, 128 along one order).
from: new angle · builds on v1 G-02 and G-08; adds the count of reports by n and family (ordered set partitions)
credit: After the postrank theory book, ch. 14, and the postrank vignette m5.
caption: Exact counts of ordered grade reports from the postrank engine; counts only, with no posterior or optimization.
